name: promptgo
description: promptgo helps creators turn images into detailed AI prompts instantly.
intro:
Alt+Right-click any image and turn it into detailed prompt analysis in English, Chinese, Japanese, and JSON.

promptgo helps creators turn images into detailed AI prompts instantly.

Alt+Right-click any image on the web, or capture a specific area of the page, and promptgo will analyze the visual details for you. It describes the subject, composition, style, lighting, colors, materials, mood, and other image details, then turns them into structured prompts you can use for AI image generation.

promptgo is designed for artists, designers, AI creators, moodboard builders, and anyone who wants to understand or recreate the look of an image more accurately.

Key features: This extension makes it easy to save images and screenshots directly to the Alphavow App.

When browsing the web, you can immediately save images of interest into Alphavow and quickly organize them.

1. Alt + Right Click: Light click to save instantly.
2. Batch Save: Collect all images on a webpage with one click.
3. Web Screenshot: Capture and save region, viewport, or full-page screenshots.
